## History

Cousin Emily operated a select boardinghouse located at [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point). Her second-cousin was urged by her own father to go stay at Emily's establishment.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002)_
